constants.name: objid_prizediamond
constants.comment: also ankh or clock after being collected

ram_variables.name: FGPlane_UpdateQueueCustom
ram_variables.detail: 10 bytes per entry: 1 word VDP control command, 2 words data

ram_variables.name: FGPlane_UpdateQueueCell
ram_variables.detail: 6 bytes per entry, 1 word xpos, 1 word ypos, 1 word in format of Level_Layout cell

ram_variables.name: Level_terrain_layout
ram_variables.detail: $20D0 bytes. 1 byte per entry (30 screens of $118 entries each)

ram_variables.name: Level_Layout
ram_variables.detail: $41A0 bytes. 16 bits per entry: block_flag(1), collision(3), block(4), skin(8)

ram_variables.name: EvanescObject_RAM
ram_variables.detail: Disappearing evanescent block RAM: ($13 objects), $C bytes per object

ram_variables.name: ShooterObject_RAM
ram_variables.detail: Shooter Block Bullet RAM: ($27 objects), $C bytes per object

ram_variables.name: Addr_FirstDPObjectSlot
ram_variables.detail: long: Diamond Power Object RAM: Address of first object slot in list

ram_variables.name: Addr_NextFreeDPObjectSlot
ram_variables.detail: long: Diamond Power Object RAM: Address of next free object slot

ram_variables.name: Addr_LastDPObjectSlot
ram_variables.detail: long: Diamond Power Object RAM: Address of last object slot in list

ram_variables.name: Diamond_power_active
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag: whether diamond power is active

ram_variables.name: Diamond_power_ID
ram_variables.detail: word: ID of active diamond power (equals HelmetID for 20-diamonds, HelmetID+10 for 50-diamonds)

ram_variables.name: V_Int_counter
ram_variables.detail: word: number of frames since start of game

ram_variables.name: V_Int_Done
ram_variables.detail: byte: Indicator that V-Int has occurred

ram_variables.name: Ctrl_1
ram_variables.detail: byte. Bitmask for controller buttons: SACBRLDU

ram_variables.name: Ctrl_1_Pressed
ram_variables.detail: byte: buttons newly pressed this frame

ram_variables.name: Ctrl_Held
ram_variables.detail: byte. depending on input mode (i.e. currently active player?)

ram_variables.name: Ctrl_Pressed
ram_variables.detail: byte. depending on input mode (i.e. currently active player?)

ram_variables.name: FGUpdateQueueCustom_NextSlot
ram_variables.detail: long: pointer to next free space in FF43BC array (FGPlane_UpdateQueueCustom)

ram_variables.name: FGUpdateQueueCell_NextSlot
ram_variables.detail: long: pointer to next free space in FF47A6 array (FGPlane_UpdateQueueCell)

ram_variables.name: Addr_EnemyLayoutHeader
ram_variables.detail: long:	Address of enemy layout header

ram_variables.name: Addr_EnemyLayout
ram_variables.detail: long:	Address of enemy layout (last 2 bytes of header)

ram_variables.name: EnemyHeader7D
ram_variables.detail: word:	enemy header, but for what? (last 2 bytes of header)

ram_variables.name: Number_of_Enemy
ram_variables.detail: word:	count number of enemies (when killing enemy it subtract 1)

ram_variables.name: Some_UFO_Shooting
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag whether there is an UFO currently locked onto the kid and shooting

ram_variables.name: KidGrabbedByHand
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag: whether hand is currently grabbing the Kid

ram_variables.name: FiveWayShotReady
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag: whether to initialize Juggernaut's 5-way shot

ram_variables.name: SamuraiHazeActive
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag: slow down objects (Samurai Haze)

ram_variables.name: Character_Movement
ram_variables.detail: word: 0 = standingstill, 1 = crawling, 2 = walking, 3 = jump, 4 climing 5 = N/A? 6 = uphill-downhill

ram_variables.name: Addr_PlatformLayout
ram_variables.detail: long: pointer into ROM for platform layout of the current level

ram_variables.name: PlatformLoader_Offset
ram_variables.detail: word: Offset in current platform layout that the platform loading manager will process next

ram_variables.name: Addr_FirstPlatformSlot
ram_variables.detail: word: Pointer to first element in platform list

ram_variables.name: Addr_NextFreePlatformSlot
ram_variables.detail: word: Pointer to next free slot in platform list

ram_variables.name: Number_Platforms
ram_variables.detail: word: Number of platforms currently loaded

ram_variables.name: Addr_PlatformStandingOn
ram_variables.detail: word: Pointer to platform kid is currently on

ram_variables.name: MurderWall_reversed
ram_variables.detail: byte: -1 = Murder wall going right to left

ram_variables.name: Game_Paused
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag. Special value of 3 when the player "gives up" in pause menu

ram_variables.name: Pause_Option
ram_variables.detail: byte: selected option in Pause menu: 0=continue, 1=restart/give up

ram_variables.name: Number_blank_top_rows
ram_variables.detail: byte: number of extra blank rows (in blocks) added to the top of the map

ram_variables.name: Level_Special_Effects
ram_variables.detail: word: 0 = None, 1 = Lava Geyser, 2 = Storm, 3 = Storm+Hail, >=4 = Invalid

ram_variables.name: Number_of_Fire_Trails
ram_variables.detail: word: max number of trails active on screen

ram_variables.name: Number_of_Arrows
ram_variables.detail: word: number of arrows on screen

ram_variables.name: Background_format
ram_variables.detail: byte (flag): 0 = pieces, -1 = enigma. (only depends on bg theme)

ram_variables.name: Fire_Demon
ram_variables.detail: byte: flag: ??? starts with 1 and subtract 1 after each kill

ram_variables.name: Background_NoScrollFlag
ram_variables.detail: byte (flag): 0 = scroll level background, 1 = no scrolling

ram_variables.name: Addr_Current_Demo_Keypress
ram_variables.detail: word: Pointer to current Keypress in Demo

ram_variables.name: Time_SubSeconds
ram_variables.detail: word: Frames until next second countdown

ram_variables.name: LevelSkip_Cheat
ram_variables.detail: flag: enable level skipping by holding A+C+Start

ram_variables.name: Current_Helmet
ram_variables.detail: The ID of the worn helmet

ram_variables.name: LevelSelect_ActNumber
ram_variables.detail: byte: number in e.g. "Elsewhere 15" or "BLW 1/2", also costume counter

ram_variables.name: LevelSelect_Flag
ram_variables.detail: byte: indicator whether to load level select as options menu

ram_variables.name: Options_Suboption_2PController
ram_variables.detail: byte: selected sub-option 1 in options menu (flag). 2 Players: One controller = 0, Two = -1

ram_variables.name: Options_Suboption_Speed
ram_variables.detail: byte: selected sub-option 3 in options menu (flag). Speed: Normal = 0, Fast = -1

ram_variables.name: Options_Suboption_Controls
ram_variables.detail: word: selected sub-option 2 in options menu: Controls (0-5)

ram_variables.name: Options_Selected_Option
ram_variables.detail: word: currently selected option in options menu, also in level select

ram_variables.name: priority
ram_variables.detail: byte: priority flag: 0=low priority, 1=high priority, 2=depends on FFF896

ram_variables.name: vram_tile
ram_variables.detail: word: tile address (index) to art in VRAM

ram_variables.name: object_meta
ram_variables.detail: word: bits 0-6: object ID, see e.g. EnemyLoad_Index. bit 7: ?, bit E: ?, bit F: flag whether berzerker recoils when hitting enemy?
